Title: Phase piece-count lookup was checked and left as it is Opening: `fable_nnue_data.PIECE_COUNT_LUT` is built with `bin(c & 15 != 0).count("1") + bin(c >> 4 != 0).count("1")`. In Python `!=` binds less tightly than `&` and `>>`, so this is `(c & 15) != 0` and `(c >> 4) != 0`. `bin(True)` is `0b1`, so each occupied nibble adds one. Headings: Phase piece-count lookup was checked and left as it is
